run_plot_single_run: run the plot_torax binary to plot a single torax simulation output file
run_plot_comparison: run the plot_torax binary to compare two torax simulation output files side by side
run_plot_custom_config: run the plot_torax binary with a custom plot_config module for tailored visualizations
run_plot_with_slider: run the plotting tool to visualize torax simulation data with an interactive time slider
run_plot_xarray_h5: run the plotting tool to read and plot torax output files in xarray or legacy h5 format
